issue.description: just check fails deterministically in the scoped/full pytest lane because tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_path_passing_audit.py::test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed reports one unreviewed live marker-path context: src/sase/ace/tui/models/_loaders/_meta_enrichment_filesystem.py:enrich_agent_from_meta. The current Grok retry diff only touches src/sase/llm_provider/grok.py and tests/llm_provider/test_grok_provider_core.py, so this verification failure is unrelated to the implemented retry fix.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The assertion compares a statically scanned set of live marker-path-passing call sites against a hardcoded review allowlist. It failed in just check after 38,790 passes and reproduced immediately in an isolated single-node rerun with the same extra key: src/sase/ace/tui/models/_loaders/_meta_enrichment_filesystem.py:enrich_agent_from_meta. There is no timing, network, or concurrency input in this check.
